scope: Targeted problem-first scoping review for native time-series forecasting foundation-model adaptation. Covers revisable supervision, aggregate/sparse supervision, and changing observation/covariate conditions.
review_type: Targeted scoping review; not exhaustive systematic review
record_count_meaning: Selected paper/model/data/artifact entries; not number of newly discovered papers or search hits. Some sources were known previously.
search_method: Web discovery followed by primary arXiv/proceedings/publisher text and official code/model/data documentation; backward reference chasing. Exact source URLs are recorded per entry. Query strings below are the recorded search terms, not a complete HTTP trace.

inclusion_criteria: Directly overlaps an adaptation constraint or provides a necessary simple comparator.
Primary technical source or official data/code artifact available.
Public by 2026-09-08; classical work included when directly relevant.
exclusion_criteria: Secondary summaries used only as discovery leads.
Pure classification/imputation/synthesis results cannot substantiate future forecasting performance.
No claim of formal acceptance from a preprint template or self-reported submission.
Abstract-only papers cannot substantiate uninspected experimental or implementation details.
access_limitations: Some OpenReview endpoints returned browser challenges; proceedings/arXiv used when possible.
Modern data payloads and pretrained weights were not downloaded during this review.
No complete bibliometric search count or PRISMA-style screening flow is claimed.
MacroCast public yearly checkpoints and monthly paper protocol are not yet reconciled.
Official code existence does not imply reproducibility or validated Windows execution.
recommended_next_action: R1 revision-data feasibility audit, then existing-method falsification; not a new PEFT method claim.

sources.title: MacroCast: A Vintage-Consistent Time Series Foundation Model for Real-Time Macroeconomic Forecasting
sources.inspection: Methods 2.4, evaluation 3.1–3.3; HTML inspected 2026-09-08.
sources.interpretation_limit: Vintage-specific fine-tuning is established; exact warm-start/reset behavior and full training reproduction remain unverified.

sources.title: Proactive Model Adaptation Against Concept Drift for Online Time Series Forecasting (PROCEED)
sources.inspection: Primary method and delayed-supervision protocol; official repository.
sources.interpretation_limit: Horizon-induced delay is not the same as later revision of an already observed label.

sources.title: Online Time Series Prediction Using Feature Adjustment (ADAPT-Z)
sources.inspection: Primary method and official conference PDF.
sources.interpretation_limit: Feature adjustment and historical gradients under delay are prior work; no local reproduction.

sources.title: Learning the Context of Errors: Black-Box Online Adaptation of Time Series Foundation Models (ORCA)
sources.inspection: Method, appendix protocol and official code existence.
sources.interpretation_limit: Input/output-conditioned residual correction with a frozen TSFM is a strong comparator; reported point metrics use medians, not a general probabilistic guarantee.

sources.title: Towards Principled Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting (FAC)
sources.inspection: Method and main backbone list.
sources.interpretation_limit: Main experiments use iTransformer, PatchTST, DLinear, OLS and FreTS; do not cite as reproduced native-TSFM evidence. Includes input/output correction variants.

sources.title: AdapTS: Lightweight Online Adaption for Time Series Foundation Model Forecasts
sources.inspection: Method: online Fourier linear forecasting, Woodbury update, forecast mixing.
sources.interpretation_limit: Already combines fast adaptation and frozen forecasts. Channel-independent; no local reproduction.

sources.title: TS-Memory: Plug-and-Play Memory for Time Series Foundation Models
sources.inspection: Method 3–4, retrieval-teacher construction and frozen-backbone interface.
sources.interpretation_limit: Offline kNN quantile teacher distilled into a small parallel model; requires realized training futures. A frozen backbone does not guarantee the mixed forecast preserves all previous performance. Official executable repository not established.

sources.title: In-Context Fine-Tuning for Time-Series Foundation Models
sources.inspection: Proceedings abstract and official method explanation.
sources.interpretation_limit: Requires a model trained to use related examples; do not assume arbitrary pretrained checkpoints have the same capability.

sources.title: Non-stochastic Bandits With Evolving Observations
sources.inspection: Official proceedings and primary abstract; indexed PDF introduction. OpenReview direct PDF challenged.
sources.interpretation_limit: Retroactively changing feedback is an established online-learning setting; its expert/bandit results are not a theorem for nonconvex LoRA.

sources.title: Corrective Machine Unlearning
sources.venue_status: TMLR 10/2024; earlier DMLR workshop version also exists
sources.inspection: Primary abstract, indexed TMLR PDF header and official code.
sources.interpretation_limit: Removing harmful training influence is prior work; partial corruption discovery differs from known statistical revisions.

sources.title: Subtract the Corruption: Training-Data-Free Corrective Machine Unlearning using Task Arithmetic
sources.inspection: Method and assumptions; code linked by paper.
sources.interpretation_limit: Proxy-derived negative task-vector editing is not new. Source-free CV corruption setup differs from streaming regression with known revised values.

sources.title: Forget or Fine-tune? A Comparative Study of Machine Unlearning Strategies for Noisy Label Correction
sources.inspection: Method, baselines and findings.
sources.interpretation_limit: Retain-set fine-tuning is a strong CV comparator in reported conditions; do not infer numerical TSFM gains.

sources.title: Learning from Label Proportions and Covariate-shifted Instances
sources.inspection: Methods, theory assumptions and correlated-bag experiments; official code.
sources.interpretation_limit: Source individual labels plus target aggregate labels already studied. Main theoretical covariate-shift assumptions do not cover arbitrary changing target conditionals; correlated bags are not entirely absent.

sources.title: Frequency Domain Predictive Modelling with Aggregated Data
sources.inspection: Primary method, assumptions, aliasing analysis and experiments.
sources.interpretation_limit: Aggregated features/labels can identify shared fine-level linear predictors under assumptions. A single aggregate's nullspace is not a universal impossibility theorem.

sources.title: Temporal Disaggregation of Time Series
sources.inspection: Original exposition and tempdisagg implementation description.
sources.interpretation_limit: Chow–Lin/Denton and movement preservation are existing methods; known-total reconstruction must be distinguished from forecasting an unknown total.

sources.title: Utilizing Load Research Data for Direct Access Forecasting and Reconciliation
sources.inspection: Operational monthly-meter/fine-sample example and forecast versus reconciliation distinction.
sources.interpretation_limit: Establishes an operational motivation, not an accessible modern customer dataset or a fine-audit acquisition-cost contract.

sources.title: Technical Note: Temporal disaggregation of spatial rainfall fields with generative adversarial networks
sources.inspection: Primary paper and official generator repository.
sources.interpretation_limit: Uses fine-resolution training data and known daily totals for reconstruction; not coarse-only future forecasting.

sources.title: Compact Latent Manifold Translation: A Parameter-Efficient Foundation Model for Cross-Modal and Cross-Frequency Physiological Signal Synthesis
sources.venue_status: 2026 arXiv preprint; formal acceptance not verified
sources.inspection: Method and high-resolution latent supervision.
sources.interpretation_limit: Frozen tokenizer does not eliminate fine training labels; public runnable code not established in this review.

sources.title: FlowState: Sampling-Rate-Equivariant Time-Series Forecasting
sources.inspection: Continuous-basis forecasting method and public model card. v3 distinguishes approximate encoder invariance from overall sampling-rate equivariance.
sources.interpretation_limit: Changing sampling rate alone is insufficient motivation for a new adapter. Does not establish all weak-supervision settings are solved.

sources.title: TRACE: A Temporal Conditional Estimation for Multimodal Time Series Foundation Models
sources.inspection: Method outline, tasks and missing-modality setting.
sources.interpretation_limit: Different TRACE from PEFT paper 2503.16991. Clinical/sentiment multimodal tasks are not native-TSFM forecasting evidence. Executable code not established.

sources.title: Are Time-Series Foundation Models Ready for E-Nose Data? An Empirical Assessment of Their Embeddings
sources.venue_status: arXiv 2606.27672v1; SENSORS2026 portal says accepted poster
sources.inspection: Primary abstract and method/task outline; official conference portal.
sources.interpretation_limit: Gas classification and concentration estimation are not automatically future forecasting; reported fine-tuning necessity is limited to studied conditions.

sources.title: TimesFM-3: A zero-shot foundation model for multivariate forecasting
sources.inspection: Official native multi-target and past/past-future covariate capabilities.
sources.interpretation_limit: Capability is not proof of robustness to a changed observation process. TimesFM2.5 LoRA example does not establish TimesFM3 training readiness.

sources.title: ALFRED help and download documentation
sources.venue_status: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.inspection: Vintage definition, release-date fallback and official download routes.
sources.interpretation_limit: Daily dates are not precise user ingestion timestamps; no payload/QC performed.

sources.title: FRED/ALFRED series observations and vintage dates API
sources.venue_status: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.inspection: realtime_start/end, output types 3/4 and vintage_dates schema.
sources.interpretation_limit: API key needed for API route; documentation availability is not verified complete historical series coverage.

sources.title: Nonfarm Payroll Employment: Revisions between over-the-month estimates, 1979-present
sources.inspection: BLS monthly initial/second/final-sample and annual revision procedure.
sources.interpretation_limit: Final sample-based estimate remains subject to annual benchmark revisions; fixed maturity is needed for scoring.

sources.title: Building Data Genome Project 2
sources.inspection: Repository scope and metadata; existing study17 has a pinned raw-data audit.
sources.interpretation_limit: Public hourly data support a controlled aggregate-access experiment, not actual monthly billing arrival timestamps; previously used panels are development data.

sources.title: Gas Sensor Array Drift Dataset
sources.inspection: Official description: 13910 samples, 16 sensors, derived 128 features and batches.
sources.interpretation_limit: Derived feature rows must not be concatenated into an invented continuous forecasting stream. No payload downloaded.

sources.title: MacroCast public model card and checkpoint manifest
sources.venue_status: Author Hugging Face repository; manifest revision 294e473968d1cf970fa05a23d5b70b8ae5c4af90
sources.inspection: Card and manifest: 26 yearly checkpoints, 1998–2023.
sources.interpretation_limit: Yearly artifacts do not reproduce all monthly refits. cutoff=1998-12 and train_vintage=1999-08.csv need interpretation; not proof of leakage. No weight download or execution.

sources.title: Modeling data revisions: Measurement error and dynamics of true values
sources.inspection: Publisher abstract and introduction: state-space model of news, noise and spillovers in revised data.
sources.interpretation_limit: Existing revision modeling and filtering, not a reproduced PEFT method; complete numerical implementation not inspected.
